agent_explanation: Body 0 reaches high speed (~92 m/s after elastic collision with heavy body 1) with large dt 0.0195 and thin wall (w=0.258). Substepping (61 substeps) is insufficient to catch the wall crossing: body 0 at step 4 is 0.54 m outside wall, at step 5 it has tunneled to overlapping -0.33 inside, also triggering no_wall_penetration. Reducing dt to 0.005 with same steps resolves it, confirming cause is discrete collision detection missing at high velocity/thin wall.
